comparison.objective: Hang steel plates on moving conveyor hooks before a deadline; candidate adjusts and locks a stationary gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Track moving hooks and thread small plate holes while controlling swing and release timing.
comparison.success_condition: Scores extraction, hook insertion, and freely settled hanging before the hook crosses a mark; candidate scores angle, lock retention, cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Dynamic target tracking and hanging do not exercise coupled fastener countertorque or retained adjustment.
